Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
---
name: Dockerfile Build Check

# Scheduled builds detect failures in external image and package dependencies.
# Pull requests build selected targets, including shared Porter build inputs.

on:  # yamllint disable-line rule:truthy
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 6 * * 1"  # Every Monday at 06:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - "feature/**"
    paths:
      - "**/Dockerfile"
      - "**/Dockerfile.tmpl"
      - "**/porter.yaml"
      - "**/porter-build-context.env"
      - "templates/workspaces/base/**"
      - "templates/workspace_services/guacamole/user_resources/guacamole-azure-windowsvm/**"
      - "templates/workspace_services/guacamole/user_resources/guacamole-azure-import-reviewvm/**"
      - ".devcontainer/**"
      - "devops/scripts/porter_build_bundle.sh"
      - ".github/scripts/dockerfile_build*"
      - ".github/workflows/build_all_dockerfiles.yml"

# Cancel superseded PR runs. Keep manual and scheduled runs independent.
concurrency:
  group: "${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}"
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  discover:
    name: Discover Targets
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read  # For path filter
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.matrix }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd  # v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Filter changes
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@fbd0ab8f3e69293af611ebaee6363fc25e6d187d  # v4.0.1
        id: filter
        with:
          list-files: json
          filters: |
            workflow:
              - '.github/scripts/dockerfile_build*'
              - '.github/workflows/build_all_dockerfiles.yml'
            build_inputs:
              - '**/Dockerfile'
              - '**/Dockerfile.tmpl'
              - '**/porter.yaml'
              - '**/porter-build-context.env'
              - 'templates/workspaces/base/**'
              - 'templates/workspace_services/guacamole/user_resources/guacamole-azure-windowsvm/**'
              - 'templates/workspace_services/guacamole/user_resources/guacamole-azure-import-reviewvm/**'
              - '.devcontainer/**'
              - 'devops/scripts/porter_build_bundle.sh'

      - name: Build matrix
        id: matrix
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          WORKFLOW_CHANGED: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.workflow }}
          CHANGED_FILES: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.build_inputs_files }}
        run: .github/scripts/dockerfile_build_matrix.sh

  build:
    name: Build ${{ matrix.target.name }}
    needs: discover
    if: needs.discover.outputs.matrix != '[]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        target: ${{ fromJson(needs.discover.outputs.matrix) }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd  # v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      # Fresh hosted jobs do not import a shared build cache.
      - name: Build target with one retry
        env:
          TARGET_KIND: ${{ matrix.target.kind }}
          DOCKERFILE: ${{ matrix.target.dockerfile }}
          CONTEXT: ${{ matrix.target.context }}
          BUILD_A
